gotchas: Group defs: when a group name does not match an ingredient category (e.g. beans vs legumes), use an explicit ID list — a category alias will silently include wrong members
node_modules must live on Linux fs and be symlinked into the NTFS workspace — execute permissions fail on NTFS mounts
Build mutation helpers must preserve the full StewBuild payload; reconstructing from ingredients only drops saved metadata.
removeIngredient must raise UnknownIngredientError on missing IDs; a silent no-op hides contract drift.
